title: Synology Docker Bridge app config
description: Input for packaging/generate.mjs. Only id, version, displayName, description, maintainer, image and an icon are required; everything else has a default.

id.description: Package name, also the share, container and Login Portal alias.

descriptionGer.description: German Package Center description; defaults to description.

dsmAppName.description: DSM class name part; derived from id (my-app -> MyApp).

appDir.description: Directory for appBuild and icon paths, relative to this file.

image.description: Local app image tag to embed.

appBuild.description: Shell command run in appDir that builds image.

icon.description: One square SVG; every DSM icon size is drawn from it (needs rsvg-convert).

containerPort.description: Port the app listens on in its container.

internalPort.description: Localhost port the bridge proxies to; derived from id.

appPath.description: Web path of the app's UI.

appUser.description: User the app runs as; defaults to the image's own. "package": the package's own DSM user (a system internal user), so DSM permissions decide which folders the app may use, and administrators get Folder access in the window.

hostTimezone.description: Set TZ to the NAS time zone (Control Panel > Regional Options), read on install and upgrade. An app's own TZ in appEnv wins.

init.description: Run a minimal init in the app container (docker run --init), for apps that start child processes.

dataDir.description: Host folder mounted at /data; defaults to the package's own share, on whichever volume.

output.description: false: the app writes nothing to a share; no folder setting, no share mount.

outputLabel.description: What the folder is called, as text or per DSM language.

outputParent.description: Older form of outputShare: its last path part is the share name.

defaultOutputDir.description: Older form of outputSubdir: its last path part is the folder name.

outputSubdir.description: First folder inside the share; defaults to id.

allUsers.description: true: every DSM user may open the app without an Application Privileges entry.

identityHeaders.description: Pass the DSM user as Remote-User and Remote-Groups.

outputShare.description: Shared folder the folder lives in. DSM creates it when missing (an existing share keeps its permissions) and the package finds it on any volume.
